title: poa fallens
intro: Poa fallens, commonly known as Poa annua's fall-blooming variant, is a type of annual grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Poa fallens include its ability to modulate the body's response to stress, promote relaxation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Poa fallens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
